invention.ref: Doors excavated from Lake Nemi (c. 1st century CE) have knob-shaped handles
invention.ref_zh: 内米湖出土的约公元 1 世纪的门已带有球形把手

notes: 来源较弱：内米湖门只是有据可查的早期实例，并非发明；工业革命后锁具与门把手才大规模生产。
summary_zh: 门把手至少有数千年历史；意大利内米湖出土、约公元 1 世纪的门上就有球形把手。
summary_en: Door handles have existed for thousands of years; doors excavated from Lake Nemi in Italy, dated to about the 1st century CE, already had knob-shaped handles.
summary_ja: ドアの取っ手は数千年前からある。イタリアのネミ湖から出土し、紀元1世紀頃とされる扉には、すでにノブ状の取っ手が付いていた。

image.alt_zh: 加拿大一扇老门上的黑色球形门把手
image.alt_en: A black knob on an old door in Canada

notes_en: Weak sourcing: the Lake Nemi doors are an early documented example, not an invention; locks and handles were mass-produced only after the Industrial Revolution.
